Safety Tips
Inspect your bike before riding
Wear an approved bicycle helmet
Ride with the flow of traffic and
signal your moves
Obey all traffic signs, signals and
lane markings
Approach intersections with
caution
Stay out of drivers' blind spots
Respect pedestrians and other
vehicle operators
If you have to ride at night, wear
reflective clothing and use a
white headlight and a red rear
reflector/light
To report damage or debris in the
bike lane, call: Street Maintenance
